incident_report.incident: Sent for sampling post-race.

Noted to have bled from both nostrils after the race.  Before being allowed to race again, STAR PERFORMER will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

C L Chau reported that his mount was unable to finish the race off over the concluding stages which he attributed to the horse racing without cover during the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

E C W Wong stated that his mount came under pressure from the 500 Metres and failed to respond to his riding thereafter.  He added that, in his opinion, the horse is better suited racing at Happy Valley.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Shortly after the start was bumped by INVICTUS and became unbalanced.

Near the 650 Metres became unbalanced when bumped by ALWAYS FLUKE which shifted in and away from ORIENTAL SURPRISE.  A Badel was fined the sum of $7,500 for returning 3 lbs overweight.  Sent for sampling post-race.

No report.

Jumped awkwardly.  Passing the 100 Metres was awkwardly placed close to the heels of MAJESTIC DELIGHT.  C L Chau reported that his mount hung in in the Home Straight and as a result proved difficult to ride out.
Bumped at the start.  Sent for sampling post-race.

M Chadwick advised that he had been instructed to hold a midfield position with cover.  He said he was obliged to settle slightly further back than anticipated in order to ensure that his mount was able to obtain cover.
Jumped only fairly.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
No report.
Bumped at the start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

J Orman advised that he had been instructed to take up a forward position.  He said after obtaining cover near the 800 Metres his mount was then taken wider making the Home Turn when MAJESTIC DELIGHT shifted out.  He added that after being eased to avoid MAJESTIC DELIGHT near the 400 Metres when that runner shifted out his mount then failed to finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

L Hewitson stated that his mount enjoyed a good run behind the lead during the event and failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight.  He added the only explanation he could offer was that the horse might be better suited racing at Happy Valley.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
In the early stages despite being ridden along did not show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position.

Withdrawn on 2.4.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame both fore) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter CIRRUS SPEED.  Before being allowed to race again, YOUNG HORIZON will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running.  After the 300 Metres was shifted to the outside of MULTISUPERSTAR when there was not sufficient room to do so, resulting in BIG RETURN making contact with LUCKY YEAR for some distance near the 250 Metres.  A Badel stated that he was given no specific instructions where to settle the horse but the emphasis was to ensure the horse relaxed during the race.  He said from his wide barrier, although the pace of the event was run outside of standard time, he was able to relax the horse during the race by settling in a position behind midfield.  A Badel pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference approaching the 250 Metres (see KYRUS TREASURE).  Sent for sampling post-race.
Throughout the early stages raced keenly and got its head up.  Raced wide and without cover from the 900 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running behind SUPER SICARIO.

H Bowman stated that his instructions were to go forward.  He said when the horse did not show sufficient pace to do so he elected to restrain his mount in the early stages to obtain a position with cover towards the rear of the field.

Jumped only fairly and then shortly after the start became unbalanced when bumped by SMILING FALCON which shifted out.  Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running.  After being shifted to the inside of SMILING FALCON near the 300 Metres then became held up for clear running behind SUPER SICARIO near the 200 Metres when that runner commenced to give ground.  As a result FLYING AMANI did not obtain clear running between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres.

Shortly after the start was crowded between FLYING AMANI and KYRUS TREASURE which shifted in slightly.  A Atzeni was fined the sum of $5,000 in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on one occasion near the 350 Metres.

Bumped shortly after the start.  M F Poon stated that after having difficulty obtaining clear running in the early stages of the Home Straight his mount was then badly hampered when crowded by BIG RETURN which shifted out near the 250 Metres.  He said as a consequence his mount finished the race off in a one-paced manner thereafter.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, LUCKY YEAR will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Bumped shortly after the start.  Leaving the 100 Metres made contact with DERRYNBLUE.  C L Chau stated that the instructions were to hold a more forward position than its previous race starts.  He said in the Home Straight MULTISUPERSTAR did not finish the race off when placed under pressure. Trainer A S Cruz confirmed the instructions issued and stated that the horse may not have been suited by being ridden in this manner.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Raced ungenerously in the early stages when being ridden forward to lead.  E C W Wong reported that he was able to obtain the lead in the early stages and set a moderate pace outside of standard time.  He said in the Home Straight he had expected SUPER SICARIO would respond to his riding given the pace it travelled in the early stages, however, his mount was disappointing in its failure to respond to his riding.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Leaving the 100 Metres made contact with MULTISUPERSTAR.  Over the concluding stages was steadied to avoid FLYING AMANI (B Avdulla) which shifted out.  B Avdulla was advised to exercise more care.

Had its right hind plate adjusted in the saddling stalls, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  Shifted in on jumping and was bumped shortly after the start.  Leaving the 600 Metres was steadied to avoid LUCKY YEAR when it commenced to race keenly.  A Badel (BIG RETURN) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 300 Metres his mount improved into a run between MULTISUPERSTAR and LUCKY YEAR where there was not sufficient room to do so, resulting in BIG RETURN making contact with LUCKY YEAR.  Then a short distance later he allowed his mount to shift out when not clear of LUCKY YEAR, resulting in LUCKY YEAR being taken out across the running of KYRUS TREASURE, resulting in KYRUS TREASURE being checked approaching the 250 Metres.  A Badel was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 15 April 2026 and to expire on Monday, 20 April 2026 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition Jockey Badel was fined $50,000.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his neutral race riding record.

Near the 250 Metres was steadied to avoid ROBOT STAR.

Apprentice Yuen was reprimanded and advised she must ensure that she stops riding and straightens her mounts whilst not clear.  Z Purton stated that when unable to cross GALLANT EPOCH and I EXCELLE in the early stages his mount was left racing wide and without cover for the  majority of the event before giving ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have blood in its mouth.
Approaching the 250 Metres was steadied to avoid ROBOT STAR.

After it was determined that the injury was too severe to be saved, LUCKY RANGER was euthanised.  L Ferraris was examined by the Chief Medical Officer and stood down from his subsequent riding engagements.  Samples were taken from the horse.

Trainer C H Yip confirmed the instructions and the reasons as to why he issued such instructions.

When questioned regarding his riding A Badel stated that he was given no specific instructions other than to settle his mount where comfortable.  He said whilst WINNING OVATION jumped well he had observed a number of runners to his inside including DROMBEG BANNER and HEALTHY HAPPY were showing intent to go forward and race in the lead.  He said when these runners showed superior pace in the early stages he elected to remain racing to their outside other than contesting the lead.  He added after travelling some distance he contemplated allowing WINNING OVATION to go forward to cross runners to his inside but he was concerned that the rider of DROMBEG BANNER would contest the lead and for this reason he elected to remain racing wide and without cover for the majority of the event where his mount was travelling comfortably.  After considering his explanation the Stewards found the tactics adopted by Jockey Badel were reasonable in the circumstances.  Sent for sampling post-race.

He said when JOHANNES BRAHMS held its position one-off and DROMBEG BANNER then shifted in slightly he was obliged to check his mount near the 1100 Metres when crowded between JOHANNES BRAHMS and DROMBEG BANNER.  Z Purton was fined the sum of $2,000 for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides after the 200 Metres.

Shifted out at the start and then was corrected by its rider.  Over the concluding stages shifted out when it attempted to savage MIGHTY STRENGTH.  Trainer J Size was advised that a warning would be placed on the racing manners of the horse as this was the first recorded occasion that ENTHUSIUM had attempted to savage another runner.

Shifted out and away from ENTHUSIUM on jumping and as a result made contact with FORTUNE BOY.  The Stewards considered a protest/objection lodged by K Teetan, the rider of the 4th placegetter, MIGHTY STRENGTH, against ENTHUSIUM being declared the 3rd placegetter alleging interference over the concluding stages.  After considering the evidence and viewing the patrol films the Stewards found that over the concluding stages ENTHUSIUM, which had been improving to the inside of MIGHTY STRENGTH, then attempted to savage MIGHTY STRENGTH, resulting in MIGHTY STRENGTH shifting out slightly away from ENTHUSIUM.  Having regard to the manner in which both horses finished the race off and the minor nature of the incident the Stewards overruled the protest/objection when they could not be comfortably satisfied that had the interference not have occurred MIGHTY STRENGTH would have finished in advance of ENTHUSIUM and weighed-in was declared on the numbers semaphored by the Judge.
No report.

Jumped only fairly.  Shortly after the start was crowded between LIVEANDLETLIVE and FAMILY JEWEL.  Near the 1700 Metres, when racing keenly, got its head up when being steadied to avoid FORTUNE BOY.  When questioned regarding his riding in the early stages of the Home Straight and the vigour he applied to his mount A Badel stated that with the early and middle stages of the race being run outside of standard time, when the race developed into a sprint home, THE AUSPICIOUS became flat-footed making the Home Turn.  He said upon entering the Home Straight his first priority was to balance THE AUSPICIOUS to give it full opportunity to finish the race off and when he was satisfied after the 300 Metres that his mount was balanced he then was able to ride with full vigour which included the use of the whip from the 250 Metres.  After considering his explanation the Stewards advised Jockey Badel, wherever possible, he should ensure he rides his mounts in a manner so as to leave no room for query.
Jumped only fairly and then shortly after was steadied when crowded by MIGHTY STRENGTH which shifted out abruptly when taken out by ENTHUSIUM.
No report.

From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 1800 Metres got its head up when being shifted in behind KARMA.  Approaching the 1600 Metres SMART AVENUE commenced to race keenly, shifted out and as a result made contact with FALLON.  FALLON then commenced to race keenly and got its head up when being positioned close to KARMA.  M L Yeung stated that with the early and middle stages of the event being run outside of standard time his mount raced keenly and was unable to finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Bumped shortly after the start.  H Bowman stated that his mount was unsuited by the early and middle stages of the event being run outside of standard time and was unable to quicken when the pace increased from the 500 Metres.  He added that when not in a competitive position over the concluding stages he did not fully ride his mount out to the end of the race.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

C L Chau reported that he was instructed to hold a position behind midfield from his wide barrier.  He said with the pace of the event being run outside of standard time in the early and middle stages his mount found it difficult to make up ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
